versions.changelog:
Initial public release with robust NTFS read-write support for macOS:

- Enables automatic, reliable NTFS read-write mounting—plug and use, no more copy failures.
- One-step installation with full self-check, dry-run mode, and simple uninstall.
- Handles major domestic network hurdles: GitHub/Formula access, Homebrew bottling issues, Clang build changes, and modern macOS launch agent system.
- Safe and reversible: automatic backups, easy rollback, no disk data modification.
- Multi-disk support with fail-safe retries and permission checks; minimizes recurring issues.
- Detailed guides and troubleshooting included for smooth user experience.
